videos.title: Tad the Lost Explorer and the Curse of the Mummy
videos.description: Animated family adventure. After Tad accidentally unleashes a curse - doh! - he and his friends must find the Emerald Tablet to save the world.

videos.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
videos.description: Madcap adventure-comedy video game adaptation with Jim Carrey and Ben Schwartz. Can nippy ring-chasing hedgehog Sonic escape the clutches of an evil moustachioed scientist.

videos.title: Rat Race
videos.description: Raucous comedy. A Las Vegas casino-owner sets up a unique game for six punters: a race across America, hunting for $2m. Starring John Cleese, Rowan Atkinson and Whoopi Goldberg.

videos.title: Spies in Disguise
videos.description: Animated spy comedy caper with the voice of Will Smith. The 'world's most awesome spy' gets framed and has to go undercover as a pigeon to prove his innocence.

videos.title: Uncharted
videos.description: Going-for-gold action. Tom Holland and Mark Wahlberg compare abs as they scour the globe for an olde explorer's lost gold. The heat is on. The time is right. Only the best survive.

videos.title: The Mechanic
videos.description: Thriller with Jason Statham and Donald Sutherland. A hitman is ordered to kill his mentor, but then takes on the dead man's son as an apprentice. Could get complicated... and deadly.

videos.title: MaXXXine
videos.description: Mia Goth stars in the conclusion to Ti West's X horror trilogy. Can Maxine Minx make the leap from porn star to bona fide actor in neon-drenched, Night Stalker-terrorised 1980s LA.

videos.title: The Entity
videos.description: Sidney J Furie's seminal horror stars Barbara Hershey as a divorced mother of three who becomes the victim of a poltergeist that submits her to multiple violent and sexual assaults.

videos.title: The Gunfighter
videos.description: Western. Gregory Peck stars as Jimmy Ringo, an ageing gunslinger searching for his estranged wife and son. But he's constantly impeded by the young bucks who are out to gun him down.

videos.title: Tooth Fairy
videos.description: Family fantasy comedy. Dwayne Johnson stars as a tough ice hockey player who is transformed into a real-life fairy as punishment for telling a child that tooth fairies don't exist.

videos.title: Deck the Halls
videos.description: Comedy. Neighbours Matthew Broderick and Danny DeVito get extremely competitive as they festoon their houses with increasingly outrageous festive decorations and lights.

videos.title: Sister Act
videos.description: Comedy starring Whoopi Goldberg. A casino singer who witnesses a Mob murder goes into hiding at a convent, where she soon has the choir rocking. With Maggie Smith.

videos.title: Sister Act 2: Back in the Habit
videos.description: Comedy sequel starring Whoopi Goldberg and Lauryn Hill. Deloris - who's now made it big in Vegas - goes back undercover as a teacher to help a struggling school choir find its voice.

videos.title: Braveheart
videos.description: Mel Gibson stars in this Oscar-laden epic as William Wallace - Scottish freedom fighter, rousing orator and keen face painter - who led his army into England, threatening the throne.

videos.title: The Killing Fields
videos.description: Oscar-winning real-life drama. American reporter Sydney Schanberg and his translator Dith Pran are separated during the Cambodian Civil War, putting Dith Pran in mortal danger.

videos.title: Imitation of Life
videos.description: Lana Turner and Oscar-nominated Juanita Moore star in Douglas Sirk's classic melodrama, which explores race relations and mother-daughter relationships. Contains racist language.

videos.title: Halls of Montezuma
videos.description: Second World War drama. Richard Widmark stars as a commanding officer leading US Marines into the Pacific to capture Japanese prisoners and discover the location of a rocket base.

videos.title: To Hell and Back
videos.description: Fact-based wartime drama. Audie Murphy, America's most decorated soldier in WWII, plays himself in this dramatic recreation of the valiant heroics that earned him the honours.

videos.title: Bridge of Spies
videos.description: Tom Hanks and Mark Rylance star in Steven Spielberg's Cold War spy drama. After gaining notoriety for defending a Soviet spy, a US lawyer then tries to free a CIA pilot.

videos.title: Wrath of Man
videos.description: Jason Statham reunites with director Guy Ritchie to give it both barrels as a mysterious hardman working for a money truck firm that keeps getting hit. Is he an inside man.

videos.title: Commando
videos.description: Thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. To free his kidnapped daughter, an ex US commando must agree to assassinate a South American president. But he's not as pliant as he seems..
